properties.evidence: Both of Anthony's physical cases — the biodome and his brother's garage — are gated on regulatory context rather than on engineering: septic and greywater rules bind 'recycles waste' harder than any pump does, and a garage needs a permit. That node already states the Environment/EnvironmentRule layer 'is what makes design a house concrete', and it is designed and unbuilt. The artifact list here stays hypothetical until it exists.
